g.text: Each column is one gene. The ZFIN, Ensembl, NCBI Gene, UniProt and RefSeq (NM_) identifiers stay constant across databases and assemblies,

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3b5a6b

g.text: whereas the chromosome accession changes with every assembly release (NC_ for RefSeq; CP_/CM_/OX_/LR_ for GenBank strain assemblies).

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3b5a6b

g.text: The ASM / fDan / fDre strain assemblies carry no gene annotation — the accession shown is the chromosome on which the orthologous

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3b5a6b

g.text: locus is projected by liftover from GRCz12tu. † Historical symbol first, current ZFIN symbol second. Sources: NCBI Gene esummary,

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #3b5a6b
